The office is not far from my home. Ben's favorite subject is music. Ben and Jack are in the same class. For example, put the papers in the red folder.
After school, we play together. Jack often helps me with music. Ben's favorite season is winter. For example, I cook breakfast on Sundays.
I am happy every day. The office is my favorite place. We often go to the gym together.
